as_told.title: Death of Chris Evans on a West Virginia bridge

plain: A researcher named Chris Evans died on the very day he was coming to meet the Ramseys, according to Scott Ramsey, a UFO crash researcher who tells it of his own family and his wife Susanna. Ramsey says Evans died in 2005 on a bridge in West Virginia and points to a West Virginia Highway Patrol report on it. He also mentions a woman named Alice Scully in telling it, and raises the death as one of the strange turns in his research.
